The '''Andoan Wars''' was a conflict between the despotic rulers of the Andoan worlds, known as the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], and the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. The war ended at the [[Battle of Raquish]] in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], a decisive victory for the Spiverelda. However, it turned into a debacle with the intervention of a sizable fleet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] which ordered the demilitarization of the sector.

==The conflict==
[[File:Lambdasector.jpg|left|thumb|The Lambda sector, where fighting occurred during the Andoan Wars.]]
The Andoan Wars, a conflict between [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]], began in the year [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]]. The Andoans, convinced that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] would do nothing more than discuss Andoan demilitarization in committee, had little concern for the prospect of Republic involvement in the fighting. The [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] known as [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] emerged as Ando's greatest military leader during the conflict, defeating the [[Free Forces]] at [[Battle of Arbular|Arbular]], [[Battle of Horos|Horos]], and finally the decisive [[Battle of Raquish]] in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]]. The victory at Raquish proved to be a debacle for Ando, however, as the firepower displayed at the battle and the ruthless tactics employed by Trench prompted the Republic to intervene, separating the two sides and sparing the Free Colonies.<ref name="EGW" />

==Aftermath==
While a sizable [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] enforced demilitarization of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the Andoan leadership was driven to radicalization by the outcome of the Andoan Wars. Ando became one of the first worlds to secede from the Republic<ref name="EGW" /> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], and [[First Minister (Ando)|First Minister]] [[Daragi Hoba]] alluded to Republic-enforced demilitarization during an address to Andoans celebrating the secession.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> Trench continued his military career after the conclusion of the Andoan Wars, serving the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Andoan Wars were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. When asked on Twitter if the Andoan Wars and [[Jorus C'baoth]]'s intervention with the [[Ando Demilitarization Observation Group]] were linked, Wallace and Fry answered this was "likely"<ref name="Tweedle Dee">{{Twitter|danwall88|status/284410969948577793|[[Daniel Wallace]]|quote=@reeldefiction I'd say it's likely but would have to defer the question to Jason for a definitive answer.|archivefile=File:DanWallace-Ando-December-28-2012.png}}</ref> and "a fair assumption."<ref name="Tweedle Dum">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/284763002111152128|[[Jason Fry]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>
